tasks.name: screen_timeout_30s
tasks.goal: In Settings, set the screen timeout to 30 seconds.
reset: adb shell settings put system screen_off_timeout 600000

verify.cmd: adb shell settings get system screen_off_timeout

tasks.name: auto_rotate_off
tasks.goal: Turn off auto-rotate screen.
reset: adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 1

verify.cmd: adb shell settings get system accelerometer_rotation

tasks.name: dark_theme_on
tasks.goal: Turn on Dark theme.
reset: adb shell cmd uimode night no

tasks.name: wifi_on_from_display
tasks.goal: Turn Wi-Fi on.

verify.cmd: adb shell settings get global wifi_on

tasks.name: clock_alarm_715
